method: Per sensor, run-length encode validity under current Silver domain rules. Count complete unusable runs bounded by original valid readings in the same uninterrupted one-second timestamp segment. Threshold is number of unusable one-second observations, not source-anchor age. Counts are sensor cells, not unique observations.
limitations: This measures candidate gap availability only, without filling values or establishing reconstruction accuracy.
Bounds on both sides use a future reading; suitable for retrospective interpolation, not immediate online prediction.
A three-cell gap ends four seconds after its preceding valid reading at its future valid endpoint.
Null, nonfinite and domain-invalid readings are combined for run detection; source categories are counted separately.
Entirely unmeasured channels are excluded from short bounded-gap candidates.

same_well_overlap_check.method: Compare complete timestamp ranges of all other cached recordings with the same well identifier against each affected recording. No overlapping same-well recording exists for either target.
